The CSV is a frequency table, so each height has to be weighted by `num_of_adults`. It covers 3,000,000 adults, and 351,546 of them are between 180 and 185 cm. That makes P(180–185 cm) ≈ 0.1172.

The bins are centred on x.5 values, so 180.5 through 184.5 fall inside the range and nothing sits on the boundaries.

P(none of three are in that range) = (1 − 0.1172)³ ≈ 0.688, which rounds to 0.69.

ANSWER: 0.69
